mechanism_narrative: A sustained quarterly GDP growth rate exceeding 5% YoY compresses equity risk premia through improved corporate earnings visibility, generating positive S&P 500 20-day forward returns as markets price in reduced macroeconomic uncertainty.
failure_condition: GDPC1 growth >5% YoY but S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in >60% of instances during the 2005-2024 sample period.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rates exceeding 7.5% signal persistent labor market slack that suppresses consumer spending growth, triggering negative equity returns as earnings expectations decline due to weak demand dynamics.
failure_condition: UNRATE >7.5% but S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in >60% of triggered periods over the 2005-2024 timeframe.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in industrial production below 96 and housing starts below 1400 units indicate manufacturing and construction sector contraction, reducing corporate revenue growth expectations and generating negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: INDPRO <96 and HOUST <1400 but S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in >60% of cases during the 2005-2024 period.

mechanism_narrative: CPI inflation below 260.0 during post-shock recovery phases indicates stable price expectations that reduce real interest rate uncertainty, driving positive equity returns as discount rates decline.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL <260.0 but S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in >60% of instances within the 2005-2024 sample.

mechanism_narrative: Payroll growth exceeding 0.5% monthly signals strengthening labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: PAYEMS growth >0.5% monthly but S&P 500 60-day returns are negative in >60% of cases during 2005-2024.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts below 1400 units indicate weak residential construction activity that reflects lagging consumer confidence, triggering negative equity returns as demand-side signals deteriorate.
failure_condition: HOUST <1400 but S&P 500 5-day returns are positive in >60% of triggered periods over the 2005-2024 window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous federal funds rate below 0.1% and CPI inflation above 259.0 indicates accommodative monetary policy amid persistent price pressures, generating positive equity returns through liquidity-driven valuation expansion.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS <0.1 and CPIAUCSL >259.0 but S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in >60% of cases during 2005-2024.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production below 96 during post-shock recovery phases reflects manufacturing sector weakness that reduces corporate output capacity, generating negative equity returns as earnings growth expectations decline.
failure_condition: INDPRO <96 during recovery but S&P 500 60-day returns are positive in >60% of instances over 2005-2024.
